title: Understanding Rollout Error in Graph World Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.27780v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: World models are increasingly used for planning by predicting future states under candidate actions. Many planning environments, however, are naturally graph-structured, with agents, tools, skills, routes, and dependencies connected through fixed or evolving relations. Understanding how prediction errors accumulate in such graph-structured rollouts is therefore critical for reliable long-horizon planning.In this work, we systematically study how rollout errors propagate in Graph World Models (GWMs). We analyze both fixed- and dynamic-edge regimes and derive topology-aware error bounds that characterize the roles of graph structure, learned dynamics, and evolving edges. We then validate these theoretical findings across synthetic graph topologies and heterogeneous agent-graph testbeds, showing that rollout error and planning regret increase with horizon and that dynamic-edge training is important when graph structure evolves. Together

translated_title: 理解图世界模型中的推演误差
translated_abstract: 世界模型越来越多地被用于通过在候选动作下预测未来状态来进行规划。然而，许多规划环境天然是图结构的，其中智能体、工具、技能、路径和依赖关系通过固定或动态演化的关系相互连接。因此，理解预测误差如何在图结构的推演中累积，对于实现可靠的长期规划至关重要。在本工作中，我们系统地研究了推演误差在图世界模型中的传播方式。我们分析了固定边和动态边两种情形，并推导出拓扑感知的误差界，刻画了图结构、学习到的动力学以及演化边所扮演的角色。随后，我们在合成图拓扑和异构智能体-图测试平台上验证了这些理论发现，结果表明推演误差和规划遗憾随时间跨度的增加而增大，并且当图结构发生演化时，动态边训练至关重要。
tldr: 本文系统研究了图世界模型中推演误差的传播机制，推导出拓扑感知的误差界，并通过实验证明推演误差和规划遗憾随时间跨度增大，且在图结构演化时动态边训练至关重要。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies rollout error propagation in Graph World Models, derives topology-aware error bounds, and empirically shows that rollout error and planning regret grow with horizon, while dynamic-edge training is crucial when graph structure evolves.
